diagnosis_from_reverse_pass.old_pt222_bottleneck: The inverse signed map is O(n) per residual, but PT222 first enumerates all 2^n x-prefixes via itertools.product and only then discovers that the residuals belong to one signed orbit.
diagnosis_from_reverse_pass.back_forth_hypothesis: Move the exact orbit certificate before child expansion: discover a polynomial-size generating set of exact signed automorphisms at the parent, quotient branch-pairs before materialization, and carry only a reversible generator word / provenance handle.
diagnosis_from_reverse_pass.forbidden_interpretation: This restricted-family test is not a proof that such generators exist or are polynomially discoverable for every CNF.

required_structure.generator_i: flip signs of exactly x_i and y_i; fix every other variable

verification_and_cost.target_complexity_for_this_family: polynomial in n and input size; no 2^n residual enumeration

negative_controls.one_clause_polarity_corruption_per_n: must reject at least the affected generator as a full-formula automorphism

promotion_gates: all frozen n values structurally match equality_family
all n exact generators verify as full-formula signed automorphisms
all generator supports are pairwise disjoint
symbolic quotient uses n+1 states and n transitions
represented raw prefix count is exactly 2^n without enumerating those prefixes
arbitrary route witness has an exact symbolic lift rule from the generator word
no import/use of itertools.product in the new probe
claim_boundary: A PASS would show that the specific blocked-equality exponential residual tree can be quotiented before birth from a polynomial-size exact automorphism certificate.
A PASS would repair the enumeration defect of PT222 only for this frozen equality family.
It would not establish a polynomial orbit-generator discovery algorithm for arbitrary CNFs.
It would not establish a polynomial bound on quotient states for arbitrary CNFs.
